A '''Selkath''' [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] took part in the [[First Battle of Ruusan]] alongside another [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Unidentified Selkath Padawan (Force lightning)|Padawan]] under a [[Unidentified Cerean Jedi|Cerean]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] in the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]]. She was [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|choked]] to death by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] [[Kopecz]], while the other was fatally struck by Kopecz's [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning.]]<ref name="DBPoG" />
